newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansa Bank dominates trade on Estonian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Hansa Bank dominates trade on Estonian bourse.

text.p: Market leader Hansa Bank dominated activity at Estonia's infant bourse on Wednesday, the Tallinn Stock Exchange said.
Overall market volume was 11.9 million kroons versus 3.1 million kroons on Tuesday and the index climbed by 0.12 percent to 97.90.
Hansa Bank's shares accounted for over 90 percent of Wednesday's turnover at 10.9 million kroons and closed at 94.00 kroons compared with 94.30 kroons on Tuesday.
Hansa Bank, the largest in the Baltic states, has attracted investor interest as it moves into neighbour Latvia and expands its activities at home.
Hansa currently has 25 percent of the market share in the smallest Baltic state.
Volume on the secondary free market also rose, from just over two million kroons on Tuesday to almost four million kroons.
